slides.headline:
"차 빼드릴게요"
!그 차로 장 보고 왔다
slides.sub:
양꼬치 먹는 사이 사라진 내 차,
블랙박스에 찍힌 20분
slides.prompt: Night street in Busan, a dark sedan pulling away from a small lamb skewer restaurant with red lanterns and steamy windows, motion blur on taillights, wet asphalt reflections, candid documentary photo, 35mm, shallow depth of field, no readable text, no faces

slides.title:
가족과 {저녁 먹던 중}
사장이 다가왔다
slides.body:
"차 좀 옮겨야 해서요, 키 주시겠어요?"
잠깐 빼고 다시 대주는 줄 알았다.
slides.prompt: Close-up of a hand handing over a car key across a restaurant table with sizzling lamb skewers on a charcoal grill, warm tungsten light, smoke, candid photo, faces out of frame

slides.title:
화장실 가려고 나왔는데
{차가 없다}
slides.prompt: An empty parking spot in front of a small Korean restaurant at night, a lone person seen from behind standing and looking around, sodium street light, documentary photo, no readable signs

slides.title:
{내 차}가
들어오고 있었다
slides.body:
운전석엔 사장.
트렁크에서 짐을 내리며 얼버무렸다.
slides.prompt: A sedan with headlights on driving into a narrow Korean alley at night, seen from the front, glare from headlights, driver silhouette not recognizable, cinematic documentary photo

slides.title:
근처 {마트}까지
20분간 운전
slides.body: 손님 차로 장을 보고 온 것이었다.
slides.prompt: Dashcam point of view through a car windshield at night arriving at a Korean supermarket parking lot, wide angle lens distortion, slightly grainy, timestamp-like overlay blurred and unreadable

slides.body:
항의하자 돌아온 사장의 말 (보도 내용 요지)
결국 식사비 11만 원 환불로 마무리됐다.
slides.prompt: Out-of-focus restaurant counter at night, a shrugging middle-aged man silhouette in background heavily blurred, receipt and car key on the counter in sharp focus, moody light
